title: Storage + hybrid keywords
format: 20 timed questions (~32 min, ~96 sec each). Underline force words before picking. Pair with the night guide.
answerDistribution: A x5 B x5 C x5 D x5

questions.question: Fleet EC2 CMS; need HA POSIX shared file system for uploads.

options.B: Upgrade one EBS volume to io2
options.C: S3 as a mounted block device

questions.question: Windows Multi-AZ + low-latency shared block (iSCSI).

options.A: FSx for NetApp ONTAP via iSCSI
options.C: FSx for Windows File Server only

questions.question: SFTP + encrypt + HA + delete after 30 days + least ops.

options.A: Transfer Family → S3 + S3 lifecycle expiration
options.C: Transfer Family → EFS + EFS lifecycle delete
options.D: Transfer Family retention policy on the server

questions.question: On-prem SMB + local cache + later Glacier from AWS.

options.A: File Gateway + S3 lifecycle to Glacier

questions.question: WORM 1 year including root.

options.C: Compliance mode + legal hold for 1 year

questions.question: Stop accidental S3 delete/overwrite; still allow deletes.

options.A: Deny all Delete in bucket policy

questions.question: Tax docs: WORM + access only from one VPC.

options.A: Network Firewall attached to the bucket

questions.question: Many private CloudFront files; do not change URLs.
Fastest one-time global upload into us-east-1 bucket.

options.D: DataSync agents everywhere for one shot

questions.question: Persistent block + object backup + archive after 30 days.

options.B: EBS + S3 lifecycle to Glacier Flexible Retrieval
options.C: EBS + lifecycle to One Zone-IA as archive

questions.question: Stem says object storage with lifecycle to archival. Default pick?
Why is S3 usually wrong for concurrent POSIX locks across ASG?

options.C: S3 is object storage without shared filesystem semantics

questions.question: EFS lifecycle policies delete files after 30 days — true or trap?

options.C: Trap — they transition to IA, not delete

questions.question: FSx Windows vs ONTAP — force word that picks ONTAP?
Legal hold for one year — valid Object Lock config?

options.A: Yes — set days on the hold
options.C: No — legal hold has no retention period

questions.question: Hybrid: need local hot cache for recent SMB files.
Mission-critical persistent disk for one EC2 database.
Transfer Family stores files by default where for least-ops SFTP→expire?
Signed URL vs cookie — force word for cookies?

options.B: no app that can set cookies ever
options.D: multiple private files without changing URLs
